test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Narmada river rises in the Amarkantak hills situated in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amarkantak Hills** is situated in Anuppur district of the state of **Madhya Pradesh** at an altitude of 1065m at the** meeting place of the Vindhya and Satpura** mountain ranges.
 
• The mighty **Narmada river** as well the **Son**, the **Mahanadi**, and **Arnadoh **which is a major **tributary of the Godavari** all **arise in the Amarkantak plateau**.
 
• There are over **24 temples** in and around Amarkantak, including the **Devi Sati temple** and the historic temple devoted to the **Goddess Narmada.**
 
• The **Trimukhi temple**, the oldest in Amarkantak, is devoted to **Lord Shiva**. Between 1042-1122 AD,** Karan Chendi,** the ruler, constructed it.
 
• Distinguished instances of **Kalchuri art** and skill can be seen in the **Machendranathh** at the **Pataleshwar temple.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Narmada River,** located in central India, has long served as a vital conduit between the Ganges River valley and the **Arabian Sea**.

 
 
• The **Greek **geographer Ptolemy named the river **Namade **in the second century CE.
 
 
 
• The river is **1,312 km long,** of which 1079 km are in Madhya Pradesh. The remaining 35 km of the river's length defines the common boundary between Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra, and the remaining 39 km between Maharashtra and Gujarat.
 
• Its principal **tributaries **are the **Burhner**, the **Halon**, the Heran, the Banjar, the **Dudhi**, the Shakkar, the **Tawa**, the **Barna **,the **Kolar**, the Ganjal, the Beda, the Goi, and the **Orsang**.
 
• Among the **projects **under construction in the basin, **Sardar Sarovar**, **Indira Sagar**, Bargi and **Omkareshwar** are the most important.
